I found nothing to fix in this pass, so I changed no files and made no commits.

The `origin/print/...` range pulls in a large merge from main, so I reviewed the print's own diff against `origin/main`. Every changed path is inside the triage's signed `touches:`, apart from the earlier stages' files under `docs/changes/…`.

- **Plan and acceptance:** every planned file is handled. `PATHS`, `pickPath`, `nextRound` and both `main.js` call sites match the brief. `test/random-path.test.js` covers all six criteria with exact checks, and the lengths are pinned to `[24, 24, 24, 26, 24]` as well as bounded. Two things differ from the plan, both on purpose:
  - The four `main.js` boots fix `Math.random` only while `main.js` loads (`try`/`finally`) instead of for the whole file. Commit d6b61be made that change.
  - The `pickPath` refusal that commit 8a67dd0 added was taken out again in 8eebdad.
- **Comments:** they say what the code does. Only `pause-speed` says "clicks and hovers", and it is the only one of the four files that hovers.
- **No fact twice:** `pickPath` uses `PATHS.length`, not a literal 5.
- **The last gate finding:** the red check on 1cadc2a is `hydraflow/verify`, a status from outside the repo, and the forge kept no log for it. The repo's own CI runs only `npm test`. I could not reproduce any failure on the current head, 8eebdad. The red may have come from the `pickPath` refusal, which 8eebdad removed, but I could not confirm that without the log.

Checks: this repo has no Makefile, and `npm test` is `node --test`.
- The ten files named in plan step 6 passed three runs in a row, 101 tests and 0 failures each time.
- I also ran the eight test files that boot `main.js` once on each of the five paths, by setting `Math.random` in a preload script kept in `/scratch`. They passed 88 of 88 every time.
- I did not run the whole suite, because the guardrails forbid it. It runs on the pull request.
